invariant_text: Every distribution extracts to an independent repository with preserved canonical source and package digests.
method: Copied src/python/safetensors/ verbatim (47 files, excluding build/.pytest_cache/etc.) into a fresh OS-temp directory with no ancestor relationship to this repository, confirmed byte-identical against the original, built a wheel+sdist from that isolated copy with its own cwd (never this repository root), built a second wheel+sdist from the in-place source at the same pinned SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and compared artifact digests.
note: Clean on the first run -- no build/-cache contamination found. This is one of product-goal.yaml's own completion invariants, separate from the 10-item gate list (installed-wheel, independent-oracle, corpus, security, resource, typing, documentation, compatibility, performance, reproducible-build). Not a certification claim -- the other outstanding program-wide invariant (all-six-co-install, already separately satisfied at FF6-EVENT-000322) and this format's own remaining obligation/gate work are tracked independently.
